products.title: Chandelier - Melt Large
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Melt Large Chandelier elevates any interior with its striking polished design and superior luminous output. Seven integrated 6W LED sources generate 3700 lumens at a warm 3000K, ensuring exceptional colour rendering with CRI above 90. The semi-metallised polycarbonate shade paired with a gold ceiling rose creates a refined, contemporary aesthetic. This premium fixture offers full mains dimmability with both leading and trailing edge control for seamless brightness adjustment. Operating at 220-240V with Class II double insulation, it delivers reliable performance across 50-60Hz frequencies. The extended 500cm clear cable enables versatile positioning, while the 50,000-hour LED lifespan guarantees decades of maintenance-free operation. German-engineered and internationally certified (CB, CE, NZ/AUS), this 51W chandelier combines efficiency with sophisticated illumination.

DIMENSIONS
196 × 164 × 196 cm
